name: Haat-bazaar (market) lists on the national portal — Sylhet Division DC and upazila portals
organization: District / Upazila administrations (national portal framework, a2i/Cabinet Division)
attribution: District / Upazila administrations (national portal framework, a2i/Cabinet Division)
notes: 45 portals read (DC + UNO). Structured lists (/pages/hatbazar, ?page=N) and static pages linked from haat-bazaar menu items; tables parsed by header (rowspan/colspan expanded). Kept: name, union, upazila, address, haat days, area, chandina-bhiti count, managing authority as published. Dropped before storage: lease (ইজারা) values, lessee names/addresses, informant names, mobile numbers, remarks; no page saved to raw/. No coordinates are published. Category: agriculture.haat when the name contains 'হাট' or market days are given, else business.market. Licence: none stated on the source; treat as government public information, cite the source.
